posts.author: Welleran
posts.body:
Genre: Action/Arcade
The evening was merry and fun, but the morning after Reid woke up as a prisoner of the Red Witch Gang! He should really pay attention when he drinks!
He must now flee, and to do it he must become Mr Tileman! Each room has a gate which can only be opened by pressing some special tiles on the floor. It sounds easy, but is it really??
"Mr Tileman" is an experimental arcade game made with RPG Maker MZ
, using only the RTP assets. Avoid monsters, pitfalls, and traps and help Reid to go home. If you fail, not even the bones will be left of him!
Link:
https://tales-of-wonder.itch.io/mr-tileman
Credits: RTP Resources (MZ),  ©Gotcha Gotcha Games Inc./YOJI OJIMA
AI usage: only for code scripts
The game has currently only 6 levels. I plan to add new ones bit by bit, for a total of maybe 20?

posts.author: Welleran
posts.body:
Version 0.2
This update adds a new level, level number 7. This a variation of Level 6, still with Kitsunes and Zombies, but the player can climb over some platforms now, giving an added "3d feels".  There is also a bunch of teleports that must be used to switch on some seals.
Old saves "should" be compatible.
Check it out!

posts.author: Welleran
posts.body:
Version 0.25
New level, level number 8, in this update.
This one is made of rocks that can be moved, a moving maze. In addition I noticed that gates were missing on level 6 and 7, making it possible for the player to just exit without switching on all the seals.
Old saves "should" work.
I hope you'll have fun!
